property_summary: For every call to burn(uint256) by the owner, the totalSupply is decreased by the burn amount; the bug makes onlyOwner always revert so burn cannot be called, therefore totalSupply never changes from the burn path for any input.
change_summary: Replace `require(msg.sender == owner)` with `require(msg.sender == address(0))` so onlyOwner always reverts, making owned() inaccessible.
